about_description: I started using computers at just 4 years old, influenced by my brother, initially through gaming. At 14, I was introduced to the world of programming, which ignited my passion for the field. At 15, I enrolled in the Technical Course in Computer Science integrated with High School at the Federal Institute of Rio Grande do Sul - Erechim Campus, where I had my first academic experiences with software development. Currently, I am an undergraduate student in Computer Science at the Integrated Regional University of Alto Uruguai and Missões (URI - Erechim). Throughout my journey, I have worked on projects using various technologies such as Java, Web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js), Flutter, C/C++, Python, and game development, in addition to experience with ERP Systems and personal projects, with a greater focus on back-end development. I have a great aptitude for learning and adapting to new technologies, along with enthusiasm and dedication to face new challenges, contribute to teams, and always seek constant evolution as a professional and individual.

portfolio_short: Personal portfolio developed with React, Tailwind CSS, and i18next, showcasing programming projects and games.
portfolio_long: Personal portfolio created with React, Tailwind CSS, and i18next to showcase my programming projects, games developed with Godot, and web solutions. The application features a responsive design, multilingual support (Portuguese and English), and displays details such as descriptions, technology stacks, and links to GitHub repositories or Itch.io demos, highlighting my skills in frontend, backend, and game development.
m83_long: This project features an educational digital game developed to enhance astronomy teaching in schools, especially in the final years of elementary education. It uses technology and gamification as support tools for learning and conceptualizing astronomy-related content.
ewaste_short: Web system for electronic waste collection routes.
ewaste_long: E-Waste is a project developed to facilitate the conscious disposal of electronic waste in the city of Santa Maria, RS. It uses interactive maps to help the community locate nearby collection points and offers detailed information about the locations and accepted materials.
fluxo_short: Web project for income and expense control, using Node.js, Express, and EJS as a template engine.
fluxo_long: Web project for income and expense control, using Node.js, Express, and EJS as a template engine. The application allows users to view their current balance, income, expenses, and to register and delete financial entries.
conta_short: Web and desktop project to calculate total hours on certificates.
conta_long: This is a web application built with Flask that allows users to upload PDF files containing hour records and returns the total sum of hours found in the documents.
competetive_short: This repository is dedicated to solving and organizing competitive programming problems.
competetive_long: Welcome to my competitive programming problem repository! This repository contains solutions for various competitive programming problems, organized by category.
colheita_short: A 2D farming game developed with Godot Engine 4.
colheita_long: A 2D farming game developed with Godot Engine 4, where the player experiences planting, caring for, and harvesting their crops in a calm and welcoming environment.
automantion_short: Controlling your home with voice commands.
automantion_long: Controlling your home with voice commands using Raspberry Pi, Arduino, RF (radio frequency) and infrared signals. This project allows you to intelligently control lights, TV, and air conditioning with spoken commands in Portuguese!
